name: nginx-multisite
description: Nginx reverse proxy with SSL termination and multi-site virtual host management for three SSL-enabled subdomains, including host-based firewall hardening (UFW, fail2ban), SSH hardening, and kernel-level sysctl security tuning.

name: cache
description: Dual in-memory caching layer that installs and configures both Memcached and Redis on the same host, with Redis configured on port 6379 with password authentication.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Full-stack Python web application provisioner that clones a FastAPI repository, sets up a Python virtual environment, provisions a PostgreSQL database, and registers the application as a systemd service running uvicorn on port 8000.
